_comment: Slag as aggregate (#236, owner 2026-08-18). Steel slag is standard road base and concrete
aggregate; this is what most of the world's slag actually becomes.
Rebar in the middle because the block is REINFORCED concrete, and the pattern says so - eight
lumps of aggregate around one bar of steel. It is also the first recipe this block has ever had:
Reinforced Concrete was worldgen-only, so a player could find it and never make it. Building
blocks are materials and stay craftable (P2.11), so that was a gap rather than a gate.
